newsitem.title: UK: Hague punters' choice to lead UK Conservatives.
newsitem.headline: Hague punters' choice to lead UK Conservatives.

text.p: Former Welsh secretary William Hague is still hot favourite to win the leadership of Britain's Conservative Party despite a strong showing by former finance minister Kenneth Clarke, bookmaker William Hill said on Friday.
William Hill quoted Hague at odds of 4-7 and said it had taken a bet of 4,000 pounds on him on Friday morning.

Clarke was second favourite at 4-1, with former social security secretary Peter Lilley at 5-1, former home secretary Michael Howard at 7-1, arch-anti-European John Redwood at 9-1 and former health secretary Stephen Dorrell 14-1.

The election to succeed John Major as party leader following the Conservatives' May 1 general election defeat at the hands of the Labour Party could be held as early as next month. --London Newsroom +44-171-542-7947
